headline: Who Owns This Chunk of Mars? Jeanine Pirro Says America Does Now.
context: Sotheby’s sold the rock at auction last year for $5.3 million. The government has now seized the 54-pound hunk of space debris — the largest meteorite from Mars ever auctioned.
